name: Sable Precision Works Mirage SPW-7 'Heat Shimmer'
description:
A thermally-cooled precision rifle that uses a cryogenic barrel jacket to eliminate heat mirage and thermal bloom from its firing signature. The Mirage SPW-7 fires conventional high-velocity rounds but wraps them in a suite of technologies designed to make the shooter invisible to thermal detection systems.

Sable Precision Works is a boutique manufacturer operating out of a single facility in GLMZ's industrial sector. They produce fewer than 200 Mirage units per year, each hand-fitted and individually calibrated. The rifle's cryogenic jacket maintains the barrel at near-ambient temperature even during sustained fire, and the weapon's stock incorporates a thermal regulation mesh that masks the shooter's body heat signature from the shoulders up.

The Mirage has become the weapon of choice for independent contractors who operate without the institutional support of corporate sniper teams. Where Arcturus shooters rely on guided rounds and overwhelming technology, Mirage operators rely on fundamentals — concealment, patience, and precision.
legality: Licensed — restricted to bonded security contractors
specifications:
caliber: 7.62mm match-grade
effective_range: 100-2,200 meters
rate_of_fire: Bolt-action, 1 round per 3 seconds
capacity: 5-round internal magazine
weight: 6.1 kg with cryogenic jacket
power_source: Micro cryo-cell, 4 hours continuous cooling
tactical_use: The Mirage excels in environments saturated with thermal detection — corporate enclaves, security corridors, and automated defense zones. While the round itself is conventional, the rifle's thermal masking transforms the operator into a gap in sensor coverage. Shooters report that security drones will scan directly over a Mirage position and register nothing. The weapon's limitation is its reliance on the cryo-cell — when the coolant runs out, the rifle is just an expensive bolt gun.
cultural_context: Sable Precision Works has cultivated a mystique around the Mirage that borders on artisanal fetishism. Each rifle ships with a hand-written card from the master armorer who built it. Independent contractors who carry Mirages form loose professional networks and share intelligence about sensor patterns and detection gaps. They call themselves 'shimmer artists.'
story_hooks: A shimmer artist was killed in their hide position — someone tracked them despite the thermal masking. Either the Mirage's cryogenic system has a flaw, or someone has developed a counter-detection method.
Sable Precision Works has gone silent — their facility is locked down and no new Mirages have shipped in months. Existing units are commanding Φ80,000+ on the black market.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, modernist bolt-action rifle with a distinctly futuristic aesthetic. The weapon has an elongated profile dominated by a prominent cryo-jacket that wraps the barrel in metallic bands and cooling vents. The stock is angular and minimalist, with a thermal regulation mesh panel running along the shooter's-side of the cheek rest. Overall impression is one of surgical precision and cutting-edge thermal technology — more laboratory instrument than brutal firearm.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 122 cm | Barrel length: 66 cm | Width (at widest point): 8.2 cm | Height (scope rail to bottom): 6.5 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Noticeably hefty despite ergonomic design. The cryogenic jacket adds substantial weight forward of the action, creating a barrel-heavy balance that demands controlled handling. Feels engineered rather than organic — precision instrument weight.
physical_description.primary_material: Titanium-alloy receiver and action, carbon-composite furniture, aerospace-grade aluminum cryo-jacket with embedded copper cooling channels
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray receiver with brushed titanium accents. The cryo-jacket has a satin-finish aluminum exterior with subtle frost patterns from thermal cycling. Thermal regulation mesh on stock is dark charcoal with a fine lattice pattern.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant: matte gunmetal gray and brushed titanium. Accents: arctic white frost patina on cryo-jacket, charcoal mesh inlays, subtle cyan glow from cryo-cell indicator window
physical_description.grip_texture: Rubberized polymer pistol grip with micro-texturing for non-slip purchase in gloved hands. The thermal mesh stock section is slightly rough, intentionally designed to break light reflection and reduce tactile signature.
distinctive_features: Prominent cryogenic barrel jacket with six copper cooling fins running lengthwise
Micro cryo-cell indicator window on the right side of the receiver glowing faint cyan
Thermal regulation mesh panel on left side of stock — woven copper and carbon fibers
Precision-machined bolt handle with minimal protrusion
Rail-mounted scope platform with integrated cooling conduit passthrough
Serial number hand-etched on the receiver in small, precise numerals
Frost bloom patterns around cryo-jacket seams from sustained thermal differential
Minimal suppressor threading on muzzle (accommodates optional cryo-rated suppressors)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: SABLE PRECISION WORKS logo laser-etched on the receiver above the magazine well in angular, minimalist font. Individual production number stamped on the left side of the cryo-jacket. Warranty plate inset into the stock with small text specifying cryo-cell replacement intervals.
physical_description.condition_typical: Meticulously maintained by contractors who understand they're operating million-Φ hardware. Cryo-jacket shows expected frost patina but is kept clean of corrosion. Finish remains sharp; any battle scars are negligible. Thermal mesh stock may show minor wear from insertion into firing positions.
